CMU.label: CMU motion capture
CMU.origin: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu). The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.

Walk_Loop: An everyday walk at a steady pace, arms swinging loosely. One stride cycle, in place
Zombie_Walk_Loop: A zombie's shamble: head and shoulders slumped forward, a dragging step, arms hanging. One cycle, in place
Jumping_Jacks_Loop: Jumping jacks: hop the feet apart while the arms swing up overhead, then back together. One jack, in place
Boxing_Guard_Loop: A boxer's guard: fists up by the face, bouncing light on the feet, weaving a little. In place
Boxing_Jab: From the guard, a straight jab with the lead fist, snapped back to the guard
Jump_Kick: A spinning jump kick (a tornado kick): a run-up, a leap that turns the body round with a high roundhouse kick in the air, landing turned away
Cartwheel: A cartwheel to the side: hands to the floor one after the other, legs wheeling over, back up to standing
Climb_Ladder: Climbing a ladder hand over hand, rising about a step a second (no ladder is drawn)
Sword_Lunge: Swordplay: from a guard, a lunge forward with the sword arm thrust straight out, then a recovery back
Run_Loop: A steady run, arms pumping. One stride cycle, in place
Sneak_Loop: Sneaking: crouched low, stepping carefully, arms held in close. One cycle, in place
Wounded_Walk_Loop: Limping on a wounded leg: a short careful step on the bad leg, a longer one on the good. One cycle, in place
Hurt_Stomach_Walk_Loop: Walking hunched over, a hand clutching the stomach. One cycle, in place
Walk_Backwards_Loop: Walking backwards at an easy pace. One cycle, in place
Crouch_Walk_Loop: Walking crouched low on deeply bent knees. One cycle, in place
Hop_One_Foot_Loop: Hopping on the left foot, the right held up, arms out for balance. One hop, in place
Run_Quick_Stop: A run that skids to a sudden stop, leaning back to brake
Run_Jump_Over: Running, a leap over an obstacle, and running on
Dive_Roll: Running, a dive forward over something into a shoulder roll, back up and running
Duck_Under: Running, ducking low under something, and running on
Jump_Twist: A kick up into a twisting flip, landing in a spin to face forward again
Punch_Combo: A fighter's punch combination from a guard: jabs, crosses and hooks
Block_Combo: Blocks from a fighting stance: forearm blocks high, middle and low
Front_Kick: A karate front kick (mae-geri): knee up, foot snapped straight ahead, back to the stance
Roundhouse_Kick: A karate roundhouse kick (mawashi-geri): the leg swings round in an arc at head height
Side_Kick: A karate side kick (yoko-geri): the body turned side on, the heel driven out sideways
Stepping_Punch: Karate stepping punches (oi-zuki): a long stride forward with a straight punch on each step
Fall_On_Face: Diving forward and landing flat on the face
Get_Up_Face_Down: Getting up from lying face down: push up on the arms, a knee under, stand
Get_Up_From_Back: Getting up from lying on the back: sit up, roll to a knee, stand
Get_Up_From_Side: Getting up from lying on the side
Duck_Thrown_Object: Ducking from something thrown: dropping into a tight crouch with the head covered, staying down, then rising
Sweep_Loop: Sweeping the floor with a broom, steady strokes (no broom is drawn). In place
Wash_Window_Loop: Washing a window: one hand wiping in circles at head height (no window is drawn). In place
Chop_Wood: Chopping wood: an axe raised overhead in both hands and brought down hard, again and again (no axe is drawn)
Dig: Digging with a spade: foot on the blade, lever back, toss the earth aside (no spade is drawn)
Rake_Leaves: Raking leaves with long pulls toward the feet (no rake is drawn)
Fishing: Fishing: a cast with a rod, waiting, then reeling in (no rod is drawn)
Pick_Up_Box: Walking up to a box, bending to lift it, and carrying it off (no box is drawn)
Carry_Heavy_Box: Moving a heavy box: squat, lift with effort, carry a few steps, set it down (no box is drawn)
Sit_Down_Get_Up: Sitting down on a chair and getting up again (no chair is drawn)
Wave_Hello: Waving hello with a raised hand
Shrug: A shrug: shoulders up, palms turned out, who knows
Stretch_Yawn: A big stretch with a yawn, arms reaching up overhead
Curtsey: A curtsey: one foot behind, knees dipping, a small bow of the head
Waiting_Loop: Waiting impatiently: shifting weight from foot to foot, looking about
Looking_Around: Standing a little hunched, looking warily about
Search_Ground: Crouching to search the ground, peering about and poking at it
Shake_Hands: Shaking hands with someone in front
Gorilla_Walk_Loop: A gorilla: hunched, knuckles low, a rolling heavy walk. One cycle, in place
Robot: A robot, acted by a person: stiff, jerky steps and arm moves in straight lines
Frankenstein_Walk_Loop: Frankenstein's monster: stiff legs, arms held straight out ahead, a heavy lurching walk. One cycle, in place
Monkey: A monkey, acted by a person: hunched, scratching, hopping about
Bear: A bear, acted by a person: heavy, lumbering, rearing up with paws raised
Dragon: A dragon, acted by a person: arms as wings, a prowl and a roar
Ghost: A ghost, acted by a person: gliding, arms floating up, a spooky drift
Chicken: A chicken, acted by a person: elbows as flapping wings, pecking, strutting
Backflip: A standing backflip: a deep swing of the arms, a jump up and over backwards, landing on the feet
Breakdance_Helicopter: Breakdance: on the floor, the legs sweeping round under the body (the helicopter)
Get_Up_Ready: Gets up from lying on the ground
Get_Up_From_Back_Ready: Gets up from lying on the back
Get_Up_Slow: A slow, unhurried get-up from lying on the floor to standing
Lie_Down: Lowers to the floor from standing and lies down
Slip_Fall: Slips as on a banana peel and falls
Rug_Pull_Fall: Falls as if a rug were pulled from under the feet
Stumble_Turn: A small stumble, turning all the way round
Bumped: Bumped by someone stumbling into them
Limp_Loop: A limping walk, favouring one leg. One stride cycle, in place
Creep_Limp_Loop: Creeping along low and careful, with a limp. One stride cycle, in place
Quarrel: Quarrelling with someone, with angry hand gestures
Explain: In conversation, explaining with hand gestures
Peekaboo: Peekaboo: the face hidden behind the hands, then shown
Comfort: Puts a comforting hand on someone's shoulder
Chicken_Dance: The chicken dance: flapping elbows and a wiggle down
Ballet_Pirouette: Ballet: expressive arms and a pirouette
Wrench_Bolt: Tightening a bolt with a wrench
Drink_Soda: Unscrews a bottle cap and drinks the soda
Pick_Up_Basket: Walks up to a laundry basket and picks it up
Hang_Picture: Hanging a picture on the wall
Ladder_Up_Down: Climbs up a ladder and back down
Step_Up_Ledge: A large step up onto a short ledge
Run_Jump_Stop: Running, jumps, stops, then runs on
Run_Over: Runs up and over an obstacle
Hop_Turn_360: A hop that turns all the way round in the air
Get_Up_Heavy: A slow, heavy get-up from lying on the floor: up to sitting, a pause, then to standing
Get_Up_From_Floor: Getting up from lying on the floor, by way of sitting
Get_Up_Via_Kneel: Getting up from lying flat, kneeling a while before standing
Get_Up_Sit_Kneel: A slow get-up from lying flat: sitting up, a long sit, a kneel, then standing
Get_Up_Labored: A labored get-up from lying flat, a little at a time, to standing
Get_Up_From_Front: Getting up from lying face down
Get_Up_Side_Roll: Getting up from lying on the side, by way of sitting and a kneel
Get_Up_Back_Quick: A quick get-up from lying on the back
Get_Up_From_Ground: Getting up from lying on the ground
Swordplay: Swordplay with a sword in the right hand, cutting and thrusting, a step or two back and forth (no sword is drawn)
Boxing_Flurry: Boxing: a flurry of punches thrown from a guard
Backpedal_Punch: Walks backwards, then attacks with a punch
Explain_With_Hands: Explaining something in conversation, with hand gestures
Angry_Quarrel: Quarreling: angry hand gestures and steps toward someone in front
